how: We read the website of every San Antonio wedding planner listed on Lazo (86 listings, 68 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: officiant and courthouse-ceremony services, venues the category lists, a vendor directory, and a Texas-and-Virginia planner whose site says little about how it works. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: Which Hill Country venues have you run a wedding at this year, and how do you plan around summer heat and outdoor ceremonies?
Full planning, partial, or wedding management only? Ask when each tier starts and how many meetings it includes.
Who is on site on the day, you or an associate, and is a second coordinator included for a larger guest count?

picks.name: Savvy Southern Events
picks.blurb: Savvy Southern Events has been licensed and insured in San Antonio, Boerne and the Hill Country since 2018, with 400-plus weddings and events behind it. Tiers run from wedding management to partial and full-service, bartending is in-house, and an extra coordinator is already included for 150 to 250 guests.

picks.name: Weddings by Diana Boucher
picks.blurb: Diana Boucher has planned luxury weddings for more than 30 years and casts her team as friend, collaborator, designer and navigator through the whole process. Based in Helotes, Weddings by Diana Boucher offers a range of planning levels and full-service planning across Texas.

picks.name: The Perfect Day
picks.blurb: The Perfect Day in New Braunfels is a full-service event production company that grew out of one bride's frustration. Since 2018 it has handled planning and design plus florals, rentals, invitations, bartending and staffing under one roof, serving New Braunfels, San Antonio and Austin.

picks.name: Wedding Whisperer
picks.blurb: Wedding Whisperer was founded in 2021 after years of helping family and friends plan their weddings, starting in 2017. Planning and coordination cover San Antonio, Austin, Houston, Corpus Christi and Gainesville, Florida, with pricing adjusted for travel.

picks.name: Sweet Gardenia Weddings - San Antonio Wedding Planner
picks.blurb: Named after the gardenia scent founder Stephanie's mother wore before big days, Sweet Gardenia Weddings started in 2018 and has grown into a team of planners, coordinators and florists. A boutique San Antonio studio built around the guest experience and the couple's story, with floral design in-house.

picks.name: Ket's Decor
picks.blurb: Ket's Decor is a full-service wedding planning, design and coordination company on Bandera Road in San Antonio, led by Ketlyne, who has over 17 years in the wedding industry. The site says the team specializes in celebrity weddings but is just as experienced with everyday ones.

picks.name: Elite Event Planning
picks.blurb: Elite Event Planning calls itself your fun-loving, detail-obsessed planning besties, with ten years of experience and a hands-on approach. Wedding management starts about 30 days out for couples who did the planning themselves; full planning and design cover San Antonio, Houston, Austin and the Hill Country.

picks.name: The Wedding Producer
picks.blurb: The Wedding Producer does luxury planning plus its own decor and rentals, a one-stop shop with real weddings at real venues shown on the site. Serves San Antonio and the surrounding area including New Braunfels, with the promise that the day feels like an experience, not a checklist.

picks.name: JC Events
picks.blurb: Jennifer and John Craft are the husband-and-wife team behind JC Events in San Antonio; John joined full time in 2021 after Jennifer built the business. Support runs from full-service planning to event management and personalized consultations.

picks.name: Brava Events
picks.blurb: Brava Events offers what it calls true event management with a smart, confident approach and more than 12 years of experience across Central Texas. Packages range from full-service planning to final touches, and every one starts with a consultation to gather the details.

picks.name: Bluebonnet Events
picks.blurb: Bluebonnet Events covers planning, coordination, floral design, bar service, staffing and rentals for weddings in San Antonio and Austin. Services scale from full planning support to day-of coordination, depending on where you are in the process.

picks.name: Your Next Chapter Event Planning LLC
picks.blurb: Your Next Chapter Event Planning is a family business working together across generations, offering wedding planning, coordination and event design in San Antonio, Austin and the Hill Country. The pitch is a wedding that feels effortless, intentional and yours.
